about: The chess flow as it was shaped, to paste into data/flows.json in task 6 with a ref on every step naming the files that exist by then. tools/flows.mjs refuses a ref to a file that is not in the repository, which is why it is here and not there yet.

flow.name: Chess, against the house
flow.who: Three people around two kinds of game on /chess. Anybody can play Everybody's move in the public game. A member can also join the waiting list and play the house one on one when their turn comes. The house is the owner's account, and it plays both games from the same page, which shows it a different face.

nodes.name: Opens /chess
nodes.note: From the pill on the rail, the row behind More, or a link. chess.html and assets/chess.js.

nodes.name: Answers the board, the moves, the queue and whose move it is
nodes.note: One request, GET /api/chess, carrying the legal moves for whoever may move now. The page asks again every twenty seconds while it is on screen, and the moment it comes back to the front. functions/api/chess.js.

nodes.name: Plays Everybody's move
nodes.note: Only while it is Everybody's turn: a tap on a piece, then on where it goes. No account needed; filed under the device the way a save is, and the move list says 'a visitor'.

nodes.name: Signs in on the map
nodes.note: The one thing a visitor cannot do here is play the house one on one. The link goes to the map's sheet and back.

nodes.name: Checks the move against the rules and files it
nodes.note: POST /api/chess move. The move names the ply it answers, so somebody else's move first is a 409 and the board redraws. functions/api/_chess.js is the rules, checked in CI.

nodes.name: Records the result
nodes.note: Checkmate, stalemate, the same position three times, fifty moves without a capture or a pawn move, not enough pieces, or a resignation. The score line counts it.

nodes.name: Every open page redraws on its next ask
Joins the waiting list
nodes.note: One place in line per account. Leave it any time before the game starts.

nodes.name: Puts them in line
nodes.note: POST /api/chess join. The queue is the private games not started yet, oldest first, and the names are on the page for everybody to see.

nodes.name: Waits for the house
nodes.note: Hours or days. The page says when the game has started, and nothing else does: the site has no address for anybody.

nodes.name: Plays their game, move by move
nodes.note: Their own board above the public one, their side at the bottom. Resign ends it early.

nodes.name: Won, lost or drawn, and free to join the line again
Opens /chess as the owner
nodes.note: The account ADMINS in wrangler.toml names. The same page with a different face: the queue first, then the games.

nodes.name: Starts a game with the first in line
nodes.note: One private game at a time; the next starts when this one ends. The challenger opens as white.

nodes.name: Turns the waiting game into a live one
nodes.note: POST /api/chess start. The member's page says so on its next ask.

nodes.name: Plays their move, in either game
nodes.note: Each board is turned round so the house's side is at the bottom.

nodes.name: Starts the next public game
nodes.note: Only once the current one has ended. The colours swap. POST /api/chess new.

nodes.name: Both boards waiting on the other side
